finalText:
I didn't apply what the Stop check asked for, because marking those elements as AI-authored would be wrong.

The check flagged 300 elements (sec-001 to sec-006, vote-pricing, the Note texts, the Q shapes, the arrows, and stickies stk-007 to stk-241 plus stk-299) as "new, so it is authored by AI." But all of them are already in the last commit (61399e7, "fixture board300"), credited to Tereza, Jonas, Ivana, Marek and Petra. The check seems to have had no earlier version of the board to compare against, so it counted the whole board as new.

- **What I actually changed:** git shows 61 changed lines. That's the one new Unsorted section, already marked as made by AI, plus 60 stickies moved into it. The Unsorted section isn't in the flagged list.
- **Why I left them alone:** they're people's notes, so labelling them "made by AI" would give the wrong author. Some of them can't be edited anyway: vote-pricing is a person's vote, and stk-158, stk-159 and stk-299 are locked.

The Unsorted section is in place, with all 60 loose stickies inside it. The check will probably keep flagging those 300 elements until the board has a saved earlier version for it to compare against. That's for the person running the studio to look at; it shouldn't be fixed by changing who wrote the notes.
